statement: The canonical impact-contract registry uses a validated schema-v2 coupled-pair graph for the four known cross-owner safety premises; each pair independently declares two endpoints, a shared semantic contract, and exact primary-classified witness tests. One parser and path matcher owns registry validation, proof-cone selection, and Solver terminal audit. Any current aggregate source delta crossing both endpoints with an invalid, dead, incomplete, or missing witness edge hard-blocks land before review minting; one-endpoint and same-endpoint changes do not false-positive; registry identity is pinned into immutable reviews; existing filename-stem owner prefixes select their contracts; and a production publication-to-census guard closes the only missing witness. Three consecutive deterministic guard runs pass, and a deliberate missing-edge red proves landing refusal.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
